text_blocks.snippet: TensorFlow is a free, open-source software library for machine learning and artificial intelligence created by Google.
snippet_highlighted_words: a free, open-source software library for machine learning and artificial intelligence created by Google

list.snippet: It is a popular deep learning framework used to train and run neural networks.
The name comes from "tensors," which are multi-dimensional data arrays that flow through computational graph nodes.
It uses a fast C++ backend with user-friendly front-end APIs, mostly in Python.
Keras: The official high-level API used to build and train models easily (tf.keras).
TensorFlow Lite: A lightweight tool for running models on mobile and edge devices.
TensorFlow.js: A library that lets you run machine learning directly in a web browser.
TensorFlow Extended (TFX): A platform for setting up production machine learning pipelines.
